request.text:
<brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> Blood on the planks and carts going over them. Trade's never been squeamish.
<long pause>
<brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: happy.> The clan wants salt, of all things. I never thought I'd have goblin custom.
<long pause>
<brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> People are buying blankets. Only blankets. Somebody knows something about this cold.
<long pause>
<brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: idle.> Prices are what they are. Don't blame the merchant for the weather.
<long pause>
<brisk market patter with worry beneath it Mood: happy.> Everything here is honest goods. Mostly honest. Ask me about the wool.
